item.title: How we MITM'd a crypto exchange platform via cache poisoning
item.author: Author
item.description: A friend of mine, 0xdln, reached out to me with a cache poisoning issue on an OpenID autoconfiguration endpoint - /.well-known/openid-configuration, on a public program on Bugcrowd, that he was struggling to showcase an impact, so we decided to dig deeper.
